tenureType.description: The type of the billing cycle

sequence.description: The order in which to run this cycle among other billing cycles

cyclesCompleted.description: The number of billing cycles that have completed

cyclesRemaining.description: For a finite billing cycle, cyclesRemaining is the number of remaining cycles. For an infinite billing cycle, cyclesRemaining is set as 0.

currentPricingSchemeVersion.description: The active pricing scheme version for the billing cycle

totalCycles.description: The number of times this billing cycle gets executed. Trial billing cycles can only be executed a finite number of times (value between 1 and 999 for totalCycles). Regular billing cycles can be executed infinite times (value of 0 for totalCycles) or a finite number of times (value between 1 and 999 for totalCycles).
